project.name: Portfolio Website
project.summary: Static TypeScript Next.js portfolio (kylet.se) with a Rust live API for stats, terminal data, and Sylphx Gateway chat.
goals: Ship the public portfolio as a static Next.js export.
Operate live stats and agent chat through Rust api-rust per ADR-168 and doctrine ADR-167 Rust-first backends.
nonGoals: Rust SSR for the marketing site (static export stays TypeScript).
Owning Sylphx Platform cluster internals or model-provider credentials.

owns.name: static-web
owns.description: Next.js static export, content, design system, and client fetch wiring in src/.

owns.name: live-api
owns.description: Rust api-rust service: /stats, /chat, terminal endpoints, persona/tools, CORS, rate limits.

owns.name: api-contract
owns.description: Protobuf + Buf SSOT in proto/portfolio/v1 with REST JSON projection for browser fetch.

doesNotOwn: Sylphx AI Gateway routing and usage accounting (SylphxAI/sylphx-ai).
Cluster deploy reconciler and ingress policy (SylphxAI/platform).

allowedDependencies.surface: Sylphx AI Gateway OpenAI-compatible HTTP API
sylphx.toml service manifest and deploy bindings

forbiddenCouplings: Import platform or gateway repository internals into this repo.
Add a TypeScript/Bun server runtime as API authority after ADR-168 S3 sunset.

delivery.deployPath: Sylphx manifest (sylphx.toml): web static image + api-rust Docker service.
delivery.productionProof: scripts/api-smoke.sh against deployed API base URL; /healthz /stats /projects /activity /chat SSE.

guardrails: No paid product surface in this repository.

gaps.description: Generate Rust types/handlers from proto/portfolio/v1 instead of hand-mirrored serde structs.
